change.before: "Istio CRDs not templated by default; Upgrade: kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml or similar"
change.after: "Istio CRDs are templated by default in istio-base; Upgrade: helm upgrade istio-base; out-of-band kubectl install/upgrade of CRDs is no longer required"

original.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the Istio CRDs are templated by default in the istio-base Helm chart, so CRDs can be installed and upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base` (CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources), while CRDs previously installed or upgraded with `kubectl apply` can continue to be managed that way and are also safely upgradable via Helm from this release onward.

corrected.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istio-base Helm chart templates the Istio CRDs by default, so CRDs can be upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base` instead of an out-of-band `kubectl apply`; CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources, and kubectl apply management continues to work.

decision.reason: [ev-85eccdc718e3][ev-2941a875a468] describe a changed interaction with Helm: the istio-base chart now templates the Istio CRDs, so `helm upgrade istio-base` upgrades them instead of an out-of-band `kubectl apply`. Existing kubectl workflows keep working, so behavior-changed with subject product-relationship:helm fits. The proposed before/after values are composite paraphrases, not literals the text states. They are optional for behavior-changed, so they are dropped (null). [ev-fa194382072a] names `Values.base.enableCRDTemplates` as now defaulting to true, but it does not state the earlier default literally, so I did not switch to that subject.
